entities.summary: Yassine El Maachi, also known as "The Showman", is Moroccan-British professional boxer. He is the former International Master champion. He won the Prizefighter series Welterweight in June 2011. After his victory, he became the first boxer ever to beat two world champions on the same night, whom are Colin Lynes and Junior Witter. He is also known by his flashy slick style, which made him the most avoided boxer in Great Britain. He is fluent in four languages: Arabic, Dutch, English and Italian. He became British citizen in 2012
